<thought>Based on the dominant m/z 127.0997 peak (likely the [M+H]⁺ ion) and the isotopic pattern (~8 % M+1, consistent with ~7 carbons), the neutral molecular mass is about 126.09 Da. A plausible formula matching this mass and containing only C, H, O is C₇H₁₁O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 127.0759 Da for the [M+H]⁺ ion, within experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C7H11O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H11O2</final_answer>
